email.subject: URGENT: Summit Ridge Construction Inc. - CPP-6612078 - Mid-Term Endorsement Request
email.body:
Hi Megan,

Please submit a mid-term endorsement request for Summit Ridge Construction Inc. on policy CPP-6612078, effective 08/15/2025.

Requested change: add a new jobsite location for ongoing ground-up construction operations at 11275 E. Dry Creek Rd, Englewood, CO 80112, and confirm the current commercial auto and umbrella limits remain in force.

Please advise if Travelers needs any additional underwriting information or a signed supplemental request form.

Thank you,
Derek Olsson
Summit Ridge Construction Inc.

Note: the policy number on the attachment may be off by a digit; the correct one ends in 9.
